title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Points Account Terms by Tier
content:
The perks points account of a Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership holds the points available to the member: points earned come in, and points redeemed, expired or reversed on returns go out. Three terms of that account vary by tier.

| Tier | Calendar months after the earn date at which unredeemed points expire | Reversing points for a return may take the balance below zero | Unredeemed points are forfeited when the membership closes |
|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| ProBuild Bronze | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| ProBuild Silver | 18 | Yes | Yes |
| ProBuild Gold | 18 | Yes | Yes |
| ProBuild Platinum | 24 | Yes | Yes |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 24 | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the terms

- **Expiry period.** Unredeemed points expire 12 calendar months after their earn date at ProBuild Member and ProBuild Bronze, 18 at ProBuild Silver and ProBuild Gold, and 24 at ProBuild Platinum and ProBuild Platinum Elite.
- **Balance below zero.** At every tier, a reversal of points for a return may take the points balance below zero, so a balance can show a negative figure after a return.
- **Closure.** At every tier, unredeemed points are forfeited when the membership closes.
